title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-99-24一模

items.zh: 这个保安负责又睿智，让公司避免了损失。
items.en: The security guard is responsible and wise enough to save the company from losses.

items.zh: 他每月从生活费中留出一笔钱，以防患于未然。
items.en: He sets  aside some money from his monthly living expenses in case of emergency.

items.zh: 为了吸引听众的注意，这个心理专家在开始讲座前，分享了他自己悲伤却励志的成长故事。
items.en: To draw the listeners’ attention, the psychological expert shared his sad but inspiring growth stories before starting the lecture.

items.zh: 这个导览机器人在很多方面有了改进，不仅可以为参观者提供需要的信息，甚至还能带他们去目的地。
items.en: The guide robot has been improved in many aspects, which means it can not only provide visitors with the information they need, but also lead them to their destinations.

proverb.en: Keep a low profile and a spotless reputation.
proverb.zh: 保持低调形象和无可挑剔的声誉。
